images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 26 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light warm ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 74 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a black wool long coat folded neatly, an ivory cream crew-neck wool knit sweater, a thick chunky navy blue tartan check wool muffler scarf folded, a small black leather shoulder bag next to a pair of black leather loafers, and charcoal straight wide slacks folded at the side. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean woman in her late 20s wearing exactly the same items: the black wool long coat worn open, the ivory crew-neck knit underneath, charcoal straight wide slacks, black leather loafers, the small black shoulder bag on her shoulder, and the thick chunky navy tartan check muffler wrapped generously around her neck with the ends tucked inside the open coat front. She is walking through a bright modern airport departure hall with plain walls and no signs, only in the lower 74 percent, headless body-only framing: the figure is cut off at the top edge of the muffler, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic wool textures, soft cool morning daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signage.
